test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The scientist says that while the complete core meltdown at Chernobyl was a major disaster, __it had fall far short of catastrophe__ many nuclear power critics had feared, the so-called ‘China Syndrome’.

options.text: it fell much short of the catastrophe
it fell far away of the catastrophe
it fell far short of the catastrophe
it fell far shorter of the catastrophe

solution:
The Correct answer is **'Option 3.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Felling far' **is just feeling a long distance.
 
• **Fell far short of:** This is a common phrasal verb that means **"to not reach a level or expectation"** (किसी स्तर या अपेक्षा पर खरा न उतरना).
 
 
• **Example**: The student's test scores fell short of his potential. 
 
 
 
• Hence, The correct option is** 'Option 3.'**

Therefore, the correct answer is** 'it fell far short of the catastrophe.'**

 Correct answer is:__ *The scientist says that while the complete core meltdown at Chernobyl was a major disaster, __**it fell far short of the catastrophe**__ many nuclear power critics had feared, the so-called 'China Syndrome.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **It fell much short of the catastrophe:** "Much" is not commonly used with "fall short of." "Far" is a more natural choice in this context.
 
• **it fell far away of the catastrophe**: "Away" is not the correct preposition to follow "fall short of."
 
• **it fell far shorter of the catastrophe: **While grammatically not incorrect, "shorter" is less natural than "short" in this phrasal verb.
